thread:
anya: Quick sync 10m: proposing a compact left-rail IA that groups Models + Versions under a single expandable section. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-rail (preview)

tom: nice. main ask: stable deep links. If someone lands on a model version URL, should the rail expand and show the version under the model?

anya: yes visually expand. UX rule: always focus the page H1 on load, not the rail. show an accessible skip link to nav.

lucy: breadcrumb copy: prefer 'Workspace / Models / ModelName (v1.2)'. truncate long names (>40 chars) with tooltip showing full name.

jamal: routing note: we'll add a small nav-map to map path patterns to nav ids, something like:
```
{
  "/w/:ws/models": "nav-models",
  "/w/:ws/models/:id": "nav-models"
}
```
We'll also canonicalize legacy query URLs to new path form.

ada-a11y: a11y checklist: 1) focus H1 on load; 2) announce breadcrumb via aria-live polite; 3) permalink menu must be keyboard reachable and have aria-expanded and aria-haspopup.

tom: analytics: tag initial page loads with load_source=deep_link|nav. also track nav.group_expand events.

anya: action items: Ill update Figma with the truncated crumb behavior; jamal to spike nav-map + redirects; ada-a11y to review aria copy. I'll open tickets and link here.
